text:
Priya Nair: FYI opening this thread for the new EU2 customer account onboarding. Scope: multi-AZ VPC, Transit Gateway topology, AWS PrivateLink to partner, and GPU quota increases (A100/p4d). Need subnet plan + NAT/egress cost estimate.
Alex R.: +1. Do we know target GPU count and whether it's burst or steady? that affects subnet sizing and ENI planning.
Priya Nair: Customer expects steady 40 concurrent A100-ish instances initially, target scale to 120 within 6 months. Prefers reserved/dedicated capacity but also wants fallback to hosted.
Marta Gomez: ok. ENI/IP requirements: Interface endpoints for PrivateLink create ENIs in each AZ per endpoint. With TGW attachments we also need enough ENIs on the spoke accounts. We should request ENI and elastic IP quotas now.
Jin Park: I sketched a CIDR plan — sharing:
```
transit: 10.254.0.0/16
account-eu2-core: 10.10.0.0/20 (spokes, infra)
account-eu2-prod: 10.11.0.0/20 (gpu clusters)
account-eu2-apps: 10.12.0.0/20
```
Keep /20 per account so we can carve multiple /24 subnets for node pools + NAT subnets.
Priya Nair: For GPU subnets we need at least 3 AZs with /24 each for spread and capacity. Suggest /19 for prod account if we expect IP-hungry setups (spot pools + bastions + ENIs). Thoughts?
Alex R.: Agree on 3 AZs. Also request ENI quota bump and EC2 instance quota for targeted instance families: p4d, p3dn, a100 variants. Onbig note: EIP limits per region — we'll need more for NAT HA across AZs unless we centralize egress through a shared NAT VPC. Central NAT reduces EIPs but adds cross-account TGW transit cost. Trade-off: per-NAT GW ~ $0.045/hr + data processing. TGW attachments cost per-VPC.
Marta Gomez: We should avoid per-VM public IPs. Plan: shared egress account with 2 NAT gateway HA pair + Centralized ALB for management. We'll request NAT gateway quota increase and VPC Elastic IP quota.
infra-bot: New support ticket created: #INC-39421 Quota increase request opened with AWS for EC2 (A100/p4d), ENI, EIP. ETA: 48-72h to respond.
Jin Park: AWS CLI template to create case (use CloudOps to submit):
```
aws support create-case --subject "Quota increase: A100/p4d eu-west-2" --service-code "Amazon EC2" --category-code "limits" --communication-body "Need concurrent 120 A100-equivalent instances in eu-west-2 within next 60 days. Current limit X -> request 140."
```
Priya Nair: Also open ticket for Transit Gateway attachments (limit is 5 attachments default). We'll need 10 attachments initially (per account + peering partners).
Alex R.: Action items: 1) CloudOps to file quota increase for EC2 GPU families, ENI, and EIP (Jin). 2) Network to approve CIDR plan (Marta). 3) Cost/arch doc for centralized NAT vs per-VPC NAT (Priya). 4) Add PrivateLink endpoint count request (we expect 6 partner endpoints across 3 AZs -> ENIs).
Marta Gomez: I'll run a quick ip-amplification test to see ENI usage per endpoint and post numbers.
CloudOps: I'll queue all quota requests after we confirm exact instance SKUs and desired concurrency. Please comment with SKU list (e.g., p4d.24xlarge / a1-neuron?), region, and desired headroom.
Priya Nair: SKU list for initial request: p4d.24xlarge (40 -> 80), g5.48xlarge (10 -> 30), a100.80gb equivalent (30 -> 60). Region: eu-west-2 (EU2). Headroom: request +20% buffer.
Alex R.: One more note: PrivateLink interface endpoints count against AZ ENI quotas, but we can mitigate by using VPC endpoint services in the partner account with NLB + endpoint in each AZ in partner side. Still need ENIs on our side for interface endpoints.
Jin Park: I'll draft the support case texts and list exact limits to bump (EC2 On-Demand limit per instance family, VPC ENI limit, Elastic IP limit, TGW attachments).
Priya Nair: Thanks — please update thread when tickets are submitted. We need to lock CIDRs and open the quota requests today to avoid delays. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex R.: +1, ping me when cases are live and I will follow up with AWS TAM if needed. :thumbsup:
